title: Vet Visit Weight Leaderboard
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vet:visit weight_kg=*
| stats sum(weight_kg) as total_value, avg(weight_kg) as avg_value by visit_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks visit type values by total and average weight across vet visit events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `weight_kg` values for each vet visit event and review total and average weight by visit type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total weight.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which visit type shows the biggest weight numbers in your vet visit data.
